name: Cheral
desc:
Cheral is a Gremor NPC. They are the camp master of [the Children of Navae](faction:the_children_of_navae) camp in the [Etrean Wilds](location:etrean_wilds).

Speaking to Cheral with a [Navaen Hostage](entity:navaen_hostage) will grant the player the Way of Navae fighting style.
additional_info: -   They wear the Navaen Nomad Robes.
